support_catalogue: q^p ordered direction words plus q retained shell occurrences; each counted occurrence carries a chosen last-direction Hamming-1 realization and its full word identifier. This chart is a declared realization of support accounting, not a proof that every p-step word equals one primitive traversal.
route: Traverse the catalogue once, one explicit hinge, and the exactly reversed catalogue; each support occurrence has a distinct event key.
admission: Bound q primitive component closures, p ordered blocks of q component return IDs, q retained shell IDs, actual support trace, core p:q, enclosure 6, lineage and certificates.
channel_support: RD of the sender's declared returned route, derived by enumerating its two branches and one hinge; receiver and sender identities are retained.
reflection_rule: At emission, lag = receiver completed reclosures minus sender completed reclosures. The forward extra reflection count is max(0,lag); the reverse count is max(0,-lag). These are declared directional delay choices from committed phase counts, not physical laws.
transport: A new return emitted at k begins its cross-return route at k+1; its arrival is k+1+RD+forward_reflection. The contact trace and phase prefixes are bound at arrival.
RCD: After two actual returned contacts on a directed channel: rho = RD + sum(forward_reflection of latest two contacts), the existing additive-count specialization.
participation: Full duration is retained in this trial; no clipping or equality of enclosure 6 with observation duration is imposed.
capacity: C3=1 for every channel, a fixed declared unit-capacity trial choice.
pressure: P_i = self RD_i + sum of admitted incoming channel durations. Nonnegative individual terms are retained even when signed currents cancel.
response: A support traversal committed at k schedules its next traversal at k+P_i using only contacts committed through k. A scheduled traversal keeps its already-committed deadline. Later arrivals affect the next scheduling decision. This integer inverse-pressure sequencer is a new declared update choice.
closure: Only completion of the whole outward-hinge-return route with a valid certificate adds a reclosure. The next route starts at the following ordered cut.
calibration: One frozen synthetic observation gain of 2 Cs-cycle equivalents per reference reclosure; calibrated on the shared pre-intervention reference history. Frequency is the exact defining 9192631770 Hz. No physical Cs realization is supplied.
metrology_scope: Ordered update cuts are not seconds. SI intervals use only the generated reference reclosure count and the frozen synthetic calibration.
background_scope: The two retained 3:4:6 fields are a finite background model. No black-hole input law or universal environmental completeness is claimed.
